\section{Principles}

The following principles apply:

\begin{itemize}
    \item Cooperation on the basis of equality and mutual benefit.
    \item Maintenance of balance between producers and consumers.
    \item Priority use of market mechanisms and fair competition.
    \item Gradual harmonisation of national legislation.
\end{itemize}

The implementation stages are:

\begin{enumerate}
    \item Establish the regulatory framework by \textbf{2024}.
    \item Launch the day-ahead market in \textit{pilot mode}.
    \item Full commercial operation from 1 January 2027.
\end{enumerate}
